_help: Copy this file to settings.json (Install.cmd does it for you). settings.json stays on your PC and is not uploaded to GitHub.
_help_contacts: Nicknames the assistant understands, for example "email Sam".
_help_models: SecretaryModel answers chat messages (haiku is fastest). SecretaryThinkModel runs mail and calendar scans, note clean-up, and the Notes editor.
_help_streams: Optional. Full path to your streams.json (Streams tab). Defaults to <OneDrive>\root\_admin\streams.json.
_help_tray: MinimizeToTray hides the Otis window when you minimize it. Click the tray icon to bring it back.
_help_alerts: ToastAlerts shows a Windows pop-up from the tray icon for reminders, meeting prompts, and emails that need you. Teams does not notify for messages you post to yourself.
